summary: Nebuchadnezzar makes gold image 60 cubits high, commands all fall down worship at sound of music, Shadrach Meshach Abednego refuse, brought before king, who says what god will deliver from my hands? They say our God able to deliver from fiery furnace, but even if not we will not serve your gods. King furious, furnace heated seven times, men bound thrown, furnace kills soldiers, king sees four men loosed walking in fire, fourth like son of gods, calls them out, no hair singed, no smell of fire, king praises God, decrees no one speak against their God, promotes them.
whyItMatters: Classic civil disobedience — faithful under pressure, God able but even if not faith, presence of fourth like son of gods in fire, and promotion after. Model for living under empire.

outline.heading: Gold image 60 cubits, command worship at music
Accusation — certain Jews not serve your gods
What god will deliver? Our God able, but even if not we will not serve
Furnace heated seven times, bound thrown, four men walking, fourth like son of gods

keyVerses.text: If it happens, our God whom we serve is able to deliver us from the burning fiery furnace; and he will deliver us out of your hand, O king.
keyVerses.why: Even if not faith — God able but trust not contingent on deliverance.

keyVerses.text: He answered, “Look, I see four men loose, walking in the middle of the fire, and they are unharmed. The appearance of the fourth is like a son of the gods.”
keyVerses.why: Fourth figure in fire — presence with.

themes: God able but even if not
fourth like son of gods in fire

questions.question: Why gold image 60x6 cubits? Connection to 666?
questions.answer: 60 cubits high 6 cubits wide — Nebuchadnezzar's statue evokes self-deification, like Tower. Some see 6x60 later echoed in Revelation number of beast. Image likely his own likeness or god Bel, music summons worship — state-sponsored idolatry with arts. Three Jews' refusal is political and theological — who is true king to bow to?

questions.question: What does 'even if not' faith mean?
questions.answer: They say God able to deliver, but even if not (i.e., God chooses not to deliver via miracle), we will not serve your gods. Faith not contingent on outcome — trust in God's ability plus submission to God's wisdom even if not. For zero-background: not testing God to prove himself, but loyalty beyond deliverance. Mature faith holds both able and even if not.

questions.question: Who is fourth like son of gods?
questions.answer: Nebuchadnezzar sees four men unbound walking, fourth like son of gods (bar elahin) — in Aramaic can mean divine being or son of gods. Jewish reading angel, Christian reading pre-incarnate Christ or angel of Lord presence. Whatever, point is presence with in fire, not just rescue from fire — God with them in furnace, not just removes furnace.

questions.question: Why no smell of fire on them after?
questions.answer: No hair singed, cloaks not harmed, no smell of fire had passed — total deliverance, not just survival. Emphasis on completeness — fire kills soldiers who threw them (v22) but not them. King then praises their God and decrees protection, promotes. Reversal: those bound now promoted, those who threw now dead.

glossary.def: Faith that God able, but trust not contingent on outcome — even if not delivered.
Aramaic bar elahin — divine being, angel, or son of gods — presence in fire.
Plain near Babylon where image set up, musicians summon worship.
